units.title: Acid-free boxes
units.text: Acid-free archival boxes reduce direct exposure to acidic cardboard and airborne dust. They also support folders so papers are not crushed when shelves are partially filled.

units.title: Relative humidity range
units.text: The paper storage room is maintained between 45 and 55 percent relative humidity. Sustained readings outside that range trigger an environmental alert.

units.title: Cold storage for photographs
units.text: Color photographic film is kept in cold storage because lower temperature slows chemical deterioration of dyes and film layers. Materials are acclimatized before opening their sealed bags.

units.title: Mold quarantine
units.text: An incoming box with visible mold is isolated from the clean collection area immediately. Conservation staff inspect it in the quarantine room before any item is rehoused.

units.title: Digitization handling
units.text: During scanning, bound volumes are supported in a cradle so the binding is not forced flat. The operator stops if opening resistance increases.

units.title: Accession identifier
units.text: The accession identifier links a received group of materials to its acquisition record and remains stable even when individual folders are later rearranged.
